description: This file defines the interface for managing properties stored in-memory, including initialization, cleanup, property retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, and bulk operations. It appears to be part of a property management service related to device or system configuration.

methods.name: initProperties
methods.description: Initializes the property settings with specified configuration and home directories.

methods.name: destroyProperties
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the property management system.

methods.name: restorePropConfig
methods.description: Restores property configuration from a temporary directory to a destination directory, possibly during maintenance or recovery.

methods.name: loadGlobalDefaults
methods.description: Extracts and applies default property values from the asset management system or branding configurations.

methods.name: createProperty
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new property object, optionally copying provided key and value strings.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the property associated with a specified key; caller must not free the returned pointer.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Creates or updates a property; indicates the result via a return code stating whether the property is new, overwritten, or if the operation failed.

methods.name: setPropertyOverwrite
methods.description: Forcibly creates or updates a property, overwriting existing values and broadcasting updates.

methods.name: setPropertiesBulk
methods.description: Efficiently applies multiple property changes in a single batch operation.

methods.name: deleteProperty
methods.description: Removes a property identified by its key.

methods.name: getAllPropertyKeys
methods.description: Returns all known property keys and their count; caller must free the returned array and strings.

methods.name: getConfigFileVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version number of the properties storage file.

methods.name: getPropertyCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of properties currently set.

ctags.name: SET_PROP_DROPPED
ctags.pattern: /^    SET_PROP_DROPPED    \/\/ dropped in favor of an existing higher priority property$/
